infobox.usage: Unlocks the driver-side door of the orange tanker truck at the construction site on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Machinery key (Machinery) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to special machinery such as tank trucks, tractors, road-building machinery, etc.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest Background Check

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Inside of the blue jackets in room 205 of the three-story dorms building. Guaranteed spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Used on the driver-side door of the fuel truck at the construction area on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: Nothing unless the quest Background Check is active.
